summary.text: Chris Eachus is a Democratic member of the New York State Assembly who represents District 99 and is running for re-election on the Working Families Party and Democratic lines.
A longtime high school science and math teacher, he served 12 years as an Orange County legislator.

paragraphs.text: Christopher William Eachus was born October 8, 1955, in San Mateo, California, spent early years in Peru, and settled with his family on Long Island.
He received a master's degree from SUNY New Paltz after attending SUNY Cortland and Cornell University.
He taught high school Advanced Placement physics, math and earth science for 40 years in the Hudson Valley, retiring from Newburgh Free Academy in 2015, and advised its solar car racing team.
Eachus was elected an Orange County legislator in 2006 and served for 12 years.
He has been active in the Sons of the American Legion, serving as Orange County commander, and sits on the 18th Congressional Veterans Advisory Board.
In the Assembly he serves on the Aging, Higher Education, Mental Health, Transportation, and Veterans' Affairs committees.
He is married to Kim and has four children and five grandchildren.
